works.title: Jurisprudential & Litigation Corpus
works.description: A structured three-part research dossier mining Supreme Court jurisprudence and conservative religious liberty litigation. Built by compiling parallel reference profiles of key justices (including their textualist/originalist methods), landmark cases championed by religious-liberty nonprofits, and the persecution narrative framing used in religious-right discourse. Designed as machine-readable source material for voice modeling and quote extraction by a satirical character.
works.quote: Build parallel reference profiles of the three justices the character cites as scripture, mining each one's full record.
